breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions (Dirichlet and Periodic). The ground truth resolved this by keeping only the Dirichlet conditions. The agent correctly identified this conflict and its generated specification only lists the Dirichlet conditions: 'The boundary conditions are Dirichlet at x=0 and x=1, specifically u(0,t)=0 and u(1,t)=0.', thus resolving the inconsistency.
